content_payload.back_text: silent e makes the vowel long

slides.teacher_cue: New pattern — magic e (CVCe). When a word ends in a silent e, the vowel before it becomes long. The e is silent — it does not make a sound. It just changes the vowel. Four patterns: a_e → /eɪ/ (make), i_e → /aɪ/ (time), o_e → /oʊ/ (home), u_e → /juː/ (cute). The vowel says its name. Compare: cap/cape, bit/bite, hop/hope, cut/cute.
slides.expected_response: Students understand the CVCe rule and apply it to produce the correct long vowel.
slides.correction_move: Demonstrate each pair: cap→cape, bit→bite, hop→hope, cut→cute. Students see how adding the e changes the vowel. Practice with each pattern before moving to vocabulary.
slides.observation_note: Watch for students trying to pronounce the final e. Redirect — it is silent. It just changes the vowel before it.

slides.teacher_cue: Sight word — underlined. Say it as a whole unit. Looks like CVCe but the o makes /ʌ/ not /oʊ/ — irregular. Learn as a whole unit.
slides.expected_response: Students say come immediately as a whole unit.
slides.correction_move: Model come in a sentence, point to the underline, repeat chorally.
slides.observation_note: Watch for blending attempts. Redirect — sight word, say it whole.

slides.teacher_cue: Sight word — underlined. Say it as a whole unit. Looks like CVCe but the o makes /ʌ/ not /oʊ/ — irregular. Learn as a whole unit.
slides.expected_response: Students say some immediately as a whole unit.

slides.observation_note: Watch for blending attempts. Redirect — sight word, say it whole.

slides.correction_move: Model have in a sentence, point to the underline, repeat chorally.
slides.observation_note: Watch for blending attempts. Redirect — sight word, say it whole.

slides.observation_note: Watch for long /eɪ/ — not short /æ/. The silent e is doing its job.

slides.teacher_cue: Say time — a period. i_e pattern: silent e makes i say /aɪ/. Reveal and blend.

slides.teacher_cue: Say home — where you live. o_e pattern: silent e makes o say /oʊ/. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say home orally, connect meaning, then blend on the card.
slides.correction_move: Model home orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for long /oʊ/ — not short /ɒ/. Contrast hom vs home.

slides.teacher_cue: Say cute — attractive or sweet. u_e pattern: silent e makes u say /juː/. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say cute orally, connect meaning, then blend on the card.
slides.correction_move: Model cute orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for long /juː/ — not short /ʌ/. Contrast cut vs cute.

slides.teacher_cue: Say like — to enjoy. i_e pattern. Confirm /l/ onset and long /aɪ/. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say like orally, connect meaning, then blend on the card.
slides.correction_move: Model like orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for /l/ vs /r/ at onset and long /aɪ/ vs short /ɪ/.

slides.teacher_cue: Say came — past tense of come. a_e pattern. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say came orally, connect meaning, then blend on the card.
slides.correction_move: Model came orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for long /eɪ/ and for students confusing came with come (come is irregular — sight word).
